edges.reason: constructor stores msg.sender as owner, granting privileged role to caller.
owner state variable is assigned from untrusted msg.sender.
initial balanceOf[msg.sender] is keyed by untrusted caller.
constructor sets infinite allowance for the UNI router.
constructor writes totalSupply.
transfer forwards msg.sender into transferFrom as _from.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_from parameter used for allowance and balance accounting.
_to parameter receives the credited balance.
_value parameter drives allowance and balance math.
msg.sender compared against _from to decide spender allowance path.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance subtractions.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) whitelist gate.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] of caller.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] without bounds.
ensure reads _from for whitelist comparisons.
ensure passes _value into condition.
ensure trusts canSale[_from] whitelist flag.
ensure compares _from with tradeAddress whitelist entry.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair via pairFor.
ensure bypasses limits when _from or _to equals owner.
condition reads _saleNum limit.
condition reads _minSale lower bound.
condition reads _maxSale upper bound.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] counter.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] for caller.
approve mutates the allowance ledger.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner privileged access.
delegate executes arbitrary delegatecall in this contract storage context.
parameter a is the delegatecall target address.
parameter b is the delegatecall calldata.
caller-supplied address a controls the delegatecall target.
caller-supplied bytes b is executed as delegatecall payload.
init requires msg.sender == owner privileged access.
saleNum parameter sets _saleNum.
token parameter sets _minSale.
maxToken parameter sets _maxSale.
init writes _minSale state variable.
init writes _maxSale state variable.
init writes _saleNum state variable.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner privileged access.
_tos array supplies recipient addresses.
_value supplies per-recipient amount.
total is computed as _value multiplied by _tos.length without overflow checks.
batchSend computes unchecked total variable.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and balance subtraction.
batchSend adds to balanceOf[recipient] in loop.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner privileged access.
addr parameter becomes the new whitelisted trade address.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress used as whitelist bypass in ensure.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is the source account argument consumed directly by the transferFrom function body.
_to is the destination account argument consumed directly by transferFrom.
_value is the amount argument consumed directly by transferFrom accounting.
_from is the address argument only consumed by the ensure whitelist logic.
_value is the amount argument only consumed by ensure/condition.
address a directly supplies the delegatecall target in the unsafe operation.
bytes b directly supplies the delegatecall payload in the unsafe operation.
addr is the sole argument assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress.
_tos is the recipient array consumed only by batchSend loop.
_value is the per-recipient amount consumed only by batchSend math.
local total is produced by the unchecked multiplication/subtraction unsafe operation.
saleNum is the argument assigned to _saleNum inside init.
token is the argument assigned to _minSale inside init.
maxToken is the argument assigned to _maxSale inside init.
